personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A skill that must see the crash in the built bundle before it touches a line is the opposite of a fix that slips a bug into production.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: One more key every repository must commit before the tool can fix a build bug; it is real only if we write the smoke.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A stop without smoke slows a fix, but a triage posted at once lets me follow every bug from the first minute.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: One committed smoke that the skill, the fix and CI all run keeps every team on the same check.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: My customers wait on a broken screen while the skill asks for a command nobody has written yet.

objection.text: When production crashes for every customer, I want the fix today. A skill that stops until someone commits a smoke command leaves my customers on the broken screen.
